scope.registration: Root-owned; this handoff does not register the module or replace existing native preflight.
scope.source_boundary: One authoritative current catalog, current core feature definitions, current project-inputs and selected core-owned bytes. No historical or generated-source fallback.
scope.generated_boundary: Existing named destination Git policy plus Check-only synchronization and exact catalog@2 provenance.
scope.dependency_boundary: Opaque selected lock bytes. This module does not reinterpret schema 2 as schema 4, choose a recipe/profile, refresh dependencies or return a native execution permit.
scope.side_effects: No projection synchronization Apply, cache creation, JDK resolution, acquisition, native planning, compilation or execution. Test-only isolated fixture publishing uses the existing Apply transaction.
non_claims: No Cargo tests or compilation were run by this agent.
No native build or launch was performed.
No byte-identical JAR or gameplay parity is claimed.
A checked snapshot does not hold a filesystem lock; recheck immediately before each later external effect.
Strict source inventory is a pre-collection gate, not a replacement for future manifest-driven native collectors.

api.collect_catalog_project: repo_root + invocation_dir + exact catalog key -> private CollectedCatalogProject; safe context/build metadata/immutable selected artifact bytes available for dependency validation before named Check
api.check_current: Consumes collected state -> private CatalogOwnedProject after exact source snapshot, destination policy, strict source inventory, Check transaction, provenance and output rechecks
api.selected_input: Exact output key -> borrowed CatalogOwnedInput; no filesystem fallback or mutable byte replacement
api.exact_authored_input: Safe full repository-relative selected source_path -> unique selected output; rejects unselected equal-hash raw files, ambiguous output aliases, declared template:true inputs and non-exact copies
api.require_exact_copy: Require explicit template:false from real CoreSelection metadata and source/output byte equality. Equal bytes alone do not prove the exact-copy role contract.
api.declared_template: Borrowed view and per-file receipt retain the selected template flag; it is never inferred from content. Every Java output still uses its controlled renderer independently.
api.ownership_identity: SHA-256 of typed portable sfm:catalog_owned_project@1 receipt
api.recheck: Recollect the same named catalog owner, repeat checks and compare exact receipt and canonical repo/project roots
receipt_fields: every selected source/output path, declared template flag, hash and byte count
api.fixture: cfg(test) tests::Fixture exposes new, key, repository, collect, publish and set_project_file_for(target, output, core-relative input, bytes, template); override preserves other target predicates

strict_generated_src_gate.contract: Complete physical src file set must exactly equal every selected artifact key under src/. All source sets and file extensions are checked; unowned Java/resources/ANTLR/arbitrary files are refused.
strict_generated_src_gate.traversal: Validate exact literal src spelling, every UTF-8 portable path, case aliases and checked file/directory paths. Reject source symlinks/junctions/reparse points even in otherwise unused directories before traversing them.
strict_generated_src_gate.empty_directories: Empty ordinary directories are not compiler inputs and are allowed; reparse directories are always refused.
strict_generated_src_gate.source_timing: Run before downstream recursive native source collection and before JDK/cache/acquisition. Check source inventory both before and after output/provenance checks.

refusal_ordering_and_legacy_bytes.v4_rewire: Keep explicit rust-toolchain argument validation first. Collect authored bytes, call unchanged selected_profile before check_current, then map checked receipt into exactly the existing NativeProjectReceipt field set and derive the existing cache identity/ancestor checks.
refusal_ordering_and_legacy_bytes.schema2: Existing V4 entry point must keep schema-2 refusal before named Check. A separately explicit frozen-recipe entry point can use the same checked ownership handle, never a fabricated schema-4 profile.
refusal_ordering_and_legacy_bytes.recipe_binding_audit: All ten reviewed recipes have thirteen unique selected exact-copy role inputs in current empty-feature project metadata. The first three rows do not need output filenames in recipe metadata: resolve only through exact source_path-selected artifacts.
refusal_ordering_and_legacy_bytes.key_identity: Arbitrary nested keys are authoritative catalog names, never parsed as MC or dependency profile. Stable target 1.21.0 has actual Minecraft 1.21.
refusal_ordering_and_legacy_bytes.generated_contributor_edits: Missing, modified, unowned or conflicting outputs refuse without repair; no auto-sync or backpropagation bypass.

actual_read_only_role_audit.method: Independently evaluated empty-feature target predicates in current project_files; every reviewed source path matched one template:false selected output and current raw SHA-256. This static role audit is not execution of the new collector.

tests_authored_not_run.matrix: All twenty arbitrary nested-key release/dev contexts across ten supported targets; exact schema-2 fixture lock bytes and target/version receipt mapping.
tests_authored_not_run.host_count: 16 active tests per Windows/Unix host; 17 total test declarations including platform alternatives.
tests_authored_not_run.legacy_receipt_proof: Construct unchanged NativeProjectReceipt fields from new checked ownership plus the same real V4 effective dependency/exclusion hashes, compare serialized receipt bytes and cache identity with the existing preflight.
tests_authored_not_run.mutable_fixture_only: Fixtures use fresh isolated Git temp repositories and non-executable synthetic build/wrapper bodies; no real game/toolchain execution or source acquisition.

gates_remaining: Root register collector and peer frozen-recipe module, run focused tests and Clippy; static rustfmt parsing is not type checking.
Root apply/review the minimal existing V4 preflight rewire preserving refusal order and exact receipt/cache fields.
Bind the eventual native plan to both checked ownership and explicit dependency preparation; recheck before every external effect.
Replace physical native directory collectors with selected-manifest collectors after this refusal gate.
Native schema-2 role completeness, source-built artifact witnesses, weak artifact trust, exact JDK, remapping and native compilation acceptance remain separate gates.
